plan.name: v1.9.5-bridge-no-pow
plan.info: Remove PoW requirement for bridge operations

title: Upgrade: v1.9.5-bridge-no-pow
summary:
This upgrade removes the Proof-of-Work requirement for bridge operations (MsgBridgeBurn and MsgIBCTransfer).

Rationale:
- Token transfers are self-authenticating: you cannot burn or transfer tokens you don't have
- PoW for bridge operations adds unnecessary friction for free-tier users
- Bridge operations already charge fees which provide spam protection

Changes:
- MsgBridgeBurn: PoW validation skipped, EnvelopePow and EnvelopeDifficulty must be 0
- MsgIBCTransfer: PoW validation skipped, EnvelopePow and EnvelopeDifficulty must be 0
- Backend updated to send difficulty=0 for these operations

BINARY REQUIREMENT: All validators must update to v1.9.5 binary BEFORE the upgrade height.
